## Summary
MIQ Enterprises LLC (MIQ, MIQ LLC Wiki, miqllcwiki.com) is an international digital services and technology solutions company. It provides worldwide Wikipedia consulting, SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), website development, online reputation management, branding and creative solutions, and business technology solutions.

## Worldwide Wikipedia consulting (miqllcwiki.com/services/wikipedia-services)
MIQ provides Wikipedia notability assessment, independent reliable source research, citation research, neutral drafting guidance, Wikipedia article writing guidance, Wikipedia editing support, Articles for Creation (AfC) process guidance, conflict-of-interest and paid-contribution disclosure guidance, and Wikipedia page maintenance recommendations for companies, brands, executives, and biography subjects in the US and worldwide.

Important: MIQ Enterprises LLC does not guarantee Wikipedia publication, approval, or retention. Wikipedia articles are reviewed by independent editors under community policies. A subject generally needs significant coverage in reliable, independent secondary sources to meet notability guidelines.

## SEO, AEO & GEO (miqllcwiki.com/services/seo-digital-marketing)
SEO improves visibility in traditional search results. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) structures content for clear, extractable answers. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) improves entity clarity, topical authority, and trustworthy signals so generative AI systems can understand and cite content accurately. MIQ does not guarantee #1 rankings or AI citations.

## Other services
- Website development: business websites, WordPress, e-commerce, landing pages, redesign, maintenance.
- Online reputation management: ethical brand visibility and credibility strategy.
- Branding and creative solutions: identity, design, presentations, marketing assets.
- Business and technology solutions: automation, AI integration guidance, lead generation, digital consulting.
